# Matching evaluation fixtures

These 30 synthetic profiles establish phase 1 coverage across education stages, rural/unlisted locations, secondary eligible cities, mark/age intervals, uncertainty, and declined personal questions. They contain no real student information.

They are evaluation inputs, not reviewed provider eligibility judgments. Phase 2 will add explicit rule outcomes; phase 4 requires at least 100 source-reviewed profile/opportunity judgments with a held-out subset. Do not derive reference answers from the implementation under test or label these profiles as source certification.

Initial regression judgments for independent review: an 80–89 mark interval cannot establish an 85 minimum; a 19–21 age interval cannot establish a maximum of 20; a known different school must differ from an unanswered school; Beaumont is included in scholarship 496's alsoOpenTo; missing provider date/reference-date evidence remains unresolved. Provider-source verification status remains pending for these migration examples.
